Judgment

1. The revisionist has filed present revision petition against impugned order dated 20.09.2022 passed by Ms. Shahzadi Halima Sadiya, Ld. M.M (Mahila Court-02), East, KKD Courts, Delhi vide which, all the accused persons/respondents herein were discharged for offences under sections 498A/406/34 IPC and only charge for offence under Section 354A IPC was ordered to be framed against respondent Firoz herein.

entities.text: M.M (Mahila Court-02), East, KKD Courts, Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. On being served with notice of revision petition, respondents entered appearance, as vakalatnama has been filed on behalf of all the respondents mentioned in ordersheet dated 31.05.2023, but no reply has been filed on behalf of respondents.

3. The brief factual matrix of the case is that complainant/revisionist gave a complaint on 26.07.2018 in CAW Cell I.P.Extension mentioning therein allegations of demand of Crl. (R) 102/23 :: 3 ::
dowry and cruelty, criminal breach of trust in respect of istridhan and of eve-teasing by the accused persons/respondents herein.

On the basis of said complaint, FIR No.
617/2018 under Sections 498A/406//34 IPC was registered against the accused persons.
Vide impugned order dated 20.09.2022, all the accused persons were discharged for offences under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC.
Only charge for offence under section 354A IPC was ordered to be framed against accused Firoz Khan.
Being aggrieved with discharge of accused persons, the revisionist/complainant has preferred the instant revision petition.
4. Ld.
Counsel for the revisionist has submitted that she was not heard before passing of impugned order.
No reasons have been given for discharging the accused persons.
Trial Court did not consider the evidence and material available on record.
It is prayed that impugned order may be set aside by allowing present revision petition.

sentences.text: On the other hand, Ld counsel for respondents has submitted that arguments of Ld. APP were heard; allegations are vague against the accused persons and no specific incident of alleged harassment or cruelty has been mentioned.
It is submitted that case filed by the complainant is a counter-blast to the case filed by respondents against the complainant.
There is no illegality or impropriety in the impugned order and revision petition deserves dismissal.
6. I have considered submissions of Ld. Counsels for the parties and perused the record.

The basis of present FIR is complaint dated 26.07.2018 given by the complainant in CAW Cell,
East District, Delhi.

In the complaint, it is mentioned that her marriage was solemnized with Asif Mohd. on 20.10.2013 and soon thereafter, her mother- in-law, father-in-law, brother-in-law (devar),
sisters-in-law (Nanands) and brothers-in-law (Nandois) used to misbehave, abuse and give beatings to the complainant on account of demand of dowry.

Complainant and her husband were assured by mother-in-law of the complainant that House no. C-113, Gali No. 3, Mullah Colony, Harijan Basti,
Gharoli Extension would be given to them to reside.

Khurshid, Salman, Abida and Jahida (Nanad and Nandoi of complainant) used to come to the matrimonial house of the complainant and exhort other accused persons to harass the complainant for dowry and taunt her for bringing less dowry.
Father-in-law and brother in law (devar) Firoz used to have an evil eye on the complainant and touch her inappropriately.

In June, 2017, when husband of the complainant was away for work,
Devar of complainant came in her room and tried to rape her and when she protested, all the family member came and tried to pacify.
8. Perusal of this complaint shows that general allegations of demand of dowry and harassment have been attributed to all the accused persons.

The complainant has made only one specific allegation of using criminal force and assault to outrage her modesty by accused Firoz Khan in June,
2017, except this, no specific allegations for demand of dowry or giving beating to the Crl.

(R)
102/23 :: 5 ::
complainant by accused persons for non-fulfillment of their demands have been made in the entire complaint.

9. In view of my above discussion, I am of the opinion that Ld. Trial Court has rightly discharged the accused persons under sections 498A/406 IPC, as on the ground that there is no specific allegation levelled by the complainant against these accused persons.
The complainant has only levelled general and vague allegations without giving specific date, time or place of alleged harassment or cruelty allegedly meted out to the complainant.
Thus, there is no substance in revision petition.

Same is hereby dismissed.
10. Trial Court record be sent back along with copy of this order.
File be consigned to Record Room.
